Title: Fast and Memory-Efficient Neural Code Completion
Venue: IEEE Working Conference on Mining Software Repositories
ReasonEN: The best model is a BPE/GRU reranker, and the paper reports that Transformer and CNN variants perform worse, so the study does not use a Transformer or LLM method (IC2).

Evidence: IC1 NO: “Our evaluation presents new insights into the effectiveness of code generation models” (Sec. 1) | IC4 NO: not reported — only pass@k correctness rates (Sec. 4.2, Sec. 5) | EC1 YES: “Our evaluation presents new insights into the effectiveness of code generation models” (Sec. 1)
